findings.title: Cleanup registers a bogus alias, so the 20 IDPs created by the test are never removed
findings.body: The cleanup `getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove)` uses the literal string "alias" instead of the created IDP's alias. Every registered cleanup therefore targets a nonexistent provider and removes nothing. The IDPs `idp-alias-0..20` (including the hidden `idp-alias-20` and the org-linked ones) leak into the shared test realm and can change results of other tests that call getForLogin or list IDPs. The same pattern exists in testCacheIDPByOrg, but the new test copies it. The fix is to capture the alias in a final variable and remove that alias.

findings.title: null and empty-string organizationId map to the same cache entry but can produce different results
findings.body: `searchKey` is `organizationId != null ? organizationId : ""`, so a null organizationId and an empty-string organizationId share the same key. In the delegate, a null organizationId means 'any org' for ORG_ONLY/ALL, while "" is passed as a literal organization id to the ORGANIZATION_ID filter. For ALL mode the cached result for one can be served for the other, returning wrong IDPs. Use a distinct sentinel or key on Objects.toString with a prefix to avoid the collision.
